Sharing copyrighted content would be a no-go, but allowing users to remotely store their own content for later personal viewing has received recent positive precedent from the appellate courts. In other words, courts ruled in 2014 that users can store their recordings remotely or in a cloud network just like a home VCR or DVR for access anywhere for personal use.

See, Fox Broadcasting Co. v. Dish Network, LLC - users can remotely store their own content.
